faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 23 vacancies: 20 Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA), 3 Industrial Trainee (CS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NHPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 20 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 20,000 for Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA), Rs. 20,000 for Industrial Trainee (CS).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passed Intermediate examination conducted by ICAI/ICMAI or CS Executive (Group 1 and Group 2 both) passed candidates conducted by ICSI. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian Nationals only need to apply. Candidates from local area will be preferred. No accommodation shall be provided by NHPC.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Candidates will be selected for the enrollment through an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Industrial training for CA/CMA shall be for a minimum period of 12 months and maximum of 15 months.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Faridabad.
